newsitem.title: UK: Fortnum & Mason to raise 5.1 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Fortnum & Mason to raise 5.1 mln stg.

text.p: Fortnum & Mason Plc on Thursday said it plans to raise 5.1 million stg via a one-for-eight rights issue to help fund a 11.7 million stg expansion plan.

The company said it is acquiring leasehold premises adjacent to its Picadilly store in London in a plan that is expected to enlarge its food sale area by about 43 percent and its total sales area by about 23 percent.
Acqusition of the leases, redevelopment and fitting out are expected to total about 11.7 million stg.
The rights issue will involve issuing up to 1,062,500 shares at 5.00 stg each, following the conversion and sub-division of each ordinary stock unit into 20 new ordinary shares.

Fortnum & Mason on Thursday also reported its pretax profits for the financial year ended July 13 rose 11 percent to 3.2 million stg from 2.9 million stg last year. Turnover gained six percent to 32.0 million stg from 30.2 million. The total dividend was increased 10 percent to 158 pence.

"If the proposed major extension to th e store is approved there will inevitably be some short term disruption to trading and to operating profits, as well as reduced interest income," the company said in a statement.
